title: The shared materials and components table: every element, mineral, ice, organic and alloy a body can contain, with the properties and equation-of-state constants of each (GEN.427)
notes: Properties: a number, its unit, the source key and the code of part E's label column (R read, C computed, H second-hand, S snippet, N not reached); a value with no source is null with the code N. Equations of state: the model and its constants as the source gives them (pressures in GPa, densities in kg/m3 unless the name says otherwise), the range they are valid over, the source and the code. Gate groups: `any` (every planet and moon class and every small-body kind) and `planetary` (planet and moon classes only: the high-pressure phases and the envelopes). A group row lists member rows and carries no number. The molar mass is computed from the formula with `physics.elements`.

sources.research-e: Part E of the body composition research, section 2.10 (docs/design/composition/body-composition-parts/E-ground-radiogenic-shielding.md): the values its label column marks R (read), H (second-hand) or C (computed); a value marked Q (recalled) is not kept

sources.crc-chemicals: CRC Handbook tables as carried in the chemicals 1.5.2 package, as read in part E (label H, second-hand)
sources.pdg-nuclear: Particle Data Group atomic and nuclear properties, nuclear interaction length, as read in part E (label R)
sources.slb2011-burnman: Stixrude and Lithgow-Bertelloni mineral parameters read in the burnman package, as read in part E (label H)
sources.e-table-2.6: Band reflectance of part E table 2.6, computed from the spectral library values it lists (label C)
sources.computed-e: Computed in part E from its other columns (molar mass, latent heat per kilogram, interaction length from oxides)
sources.handbook-mineralogy: Anthony, Bideaux, Bladh and Nichols, Handbook of Mineralogy, Mineralogical Society of America (Mineral Data Publishing, 2001-2005), the page of the mineral: D(calc.) and D(meas.)

sources.crc-density-wiki: Densities of the elements (data page), Wikipedia, the row marked 'use' (CRC and WebElements values); the handbook itself was not read

sources.ideal-gas: The ideal gas law rho = P M / (R T); exact, no constants of its own
